primary: classical signed R2PT, partition exponent delta=1, Gaussian VACF taper tau=10, equal partial volumes 1/rho
systems: all eight completed compositions, 24 existing trajectories
mechanical_label_handling: merge exactly identical mechanical species before estimating entropy; retain per-label diagnostic for L5
velocity_sampling: all retained ions; first 200 retained IDs per distinct neutral interaction; same IDs in U4/L5 null
spectral_estimator: full biased finite-record autocorrelation, optional Gaussian taper, cosine transform through Nyquist, explicit equipartition normalization by C(0)
entropy_reference: classical ideal mixture at same total density, temperature and composition; arbitrary h cancels; no quantum correction
reference_volume_sensitivity: volume-conserving +/-10% changes in probe or secondary-solvent partial volume, purely a model stress test
statistical_intervals: nominal 95% paired-replica Student-t intervals, df=2; halves and overlapping origins are sensitivities, not independent replicas
scope_limit: equal-partial-volume mixture approximation is tested, not asserted exact for these electrolytes; signed residual is R2PT bookkeeping, not a nonnegative physical mode population
